The La0.008Al0.08FeCoCrNiMn HEA was prepared by medium-frequency induction melting in a high-purify argon environment.
the molten alloy was sucked into an yttrium oxide tube (inner diameter: 6 mm, external diameter: 8 mm) and quenched into the 25 °C liquid metal (Ga-In-Sn) rapidly.
The Φ6 mm ingot was subjected to cold rolling (CR) using a laboratory-scale rolling mill to a final thickness of ~0.7 mm, reducing 88.3%.
The further annealing treatments were done in this cold rolling alloy at 600 °C for 1 min (CR + A 1 min)

The as-cast sample shows a yield strength (YS) of 204 MPa
The hardness of the as-cast La0.008Al0.08FeCoCrNiMn HEA sample is 112 HV.
After cold rolling at 25 °C, the YS increased to 1009 MPa
After the cold rolling, the hardness of the HEA increased to 327 HV.
the maximum value reaches 355 HV at 32 min.
After the 360 min annealing, the hardness is 306 HV.

The nano-twins strengthening is also a practical strengthening approach due to serve as effective barriers against the dislocation transmission
